name: Rejection Reason 1 Choice
definition: Allows the sender of the rejection message to indicate only one rejection reason that applies to the entire rejected message.

GlobalRejectionReason.name: Global Rejection Reason
GlobalRejectionReason.definition: Rejection reason that applies to the whole report.

RejectedElement.name: Rejected Element
RejectedElement.definition: Specifies a rejection reason for each individual element of a report.
